summary: iter249 onboarding state machine + /welcome 5-step flow tested end-to-end. 15/15 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend renders all 5 steps correctly with proper data-testids, fires POST /onboarding/start on path pick, POST /onboarding/step on first-action click (opens correct new tab), reaches 'You're all set' on last tour stop, and refresh-resume from step 3 works. Skip button is broken — fixed Nav header (z-50) overlaps welcome-skip and intercepts pointer events, so clicking the skip button in a real browser does NOT fire the skip() handler (localStorage flag never set + POST /onboarding/skip never sent). Welcome email send-path verified by mailgun call being attempted with authed maker JWT (welcome_email_sent_at field present on the state record).

ui_bugs.issue: The top row containing [data-testid='welcome-skip'] and [data-testid='welcome-progress'] is overlapped by the fixed <Nav> header (data-testid='site-nav', z-50). In a real browser, clicking the skip button is intercepted by the Nav (pointer-events from the Nav header subtree intercept the click). Result: skip() handler does NOT run — POST /onboarding/skip is never fired, localStorage.cm_onboarding_skipped is never set to '1'. The Welcome container uses pt-24 (96px) but with the BetaBanner (40px) + Nav (~64px) = ~104px of fixed UI above, leaving a ~8px overlap that captures clicks. Playwright with force=True can navigate-away but still does not actually execute the skip handler.

issues: Add ~32-48px additional top padding (pt-32 or pt-36) OR remove the fixed Nav for the /welcome route, OR move the progress-dots + skip button below the fold of the Nav. Current layout makes the critical 'skip' exit broken on every step.

action_items: Fix Welcome.jsx top-spacing — increase pt-24 → pt-32/36 or render Welcome outside the fixed Nav layout, so [data-testid='welcome-skip'] is clickable on every step. Verify by clicking skip in a real browser without force=True.
(Optional polish) Consider also fixing the same overlap-risk for [data-testid='welcome-progress'] dots — they are in the same row and may also be partly covered.
critical_code_review_comments: onboarding.py:99 — _send_welcome_email failures only log + swallow; if mailgun rate-limits or returns 4xx the user gets no signal. Consider stamping a welcome_email_failed_at + last_email_error for admin visibility.

onboarding.py:131-142 — /step auto-creates state if missing, but doesn't capture body.user_type. If a client somehow POSTs /step before /start, the state is created without user_type — that's fine for analytics but means the per-role completion email never fires retroactively.
Welcome.jsx:111 — useEffect fires GET /onboarding/me on every mount; multiple back-and-forth navigations would re-hit it. Fine for now but consider caching in localStorage.

Welcome.jsx:113 — markStep swallows errors silently — if backend is down, completed steps don't persist and refresh-resume will silently lose progress. Should at least log to console or show a tiny non-blocking toast.

Welcome.jsx:349 — handleAction calls onMark (POST /step) but doesn't await before window.open — on slow connections the step may not be persisted if user closes the tab immediately. Already uses await though, so good.
test_credentials: Used maker_auth.issue_session_jwt('iron-and-oak', 'iron-and-oak@craftersmarket.org', 'maker') for authed-skip test, and a synthetic test-maker-<rand> slug for the welcome-email path test (avoids polluting iron-and-oak's onboarding state).
seed_data_creation: Test docs created in db.onboarding_states with user_key like anon_test_<uuid> and test-maker-<uuid>. These can be cleaned later via db.onboarding_states.delete_many({'user_key': /^anon_test_/}) but are otherwise harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is solid — re-run /app/backend/tests/test_onboarding.py for regression. Frontend's only bug is the Nav overlap on the skip button. After main agent bumps pt-24→pt-32 (or similar), retest by: (1) goto /welcome, (2) click [data-testid='welcome-skip'] WITHOUT force=True, (3) verify localStorage.cm_onboarding_skipped === '1' and a POST /api/onboarding/skip in network log, (4) verify navigation to /. Also retest on step 2/3/4/5 — the skip row appears on every step.
rca of the issue: Welcome page container uses `pt-24 pb-20 px-4 md:px-8` and the progress-dots + skip button row is the first child inside it with `mb-8`. The site Nav header is fixed at top: 0 with z-50 and (combined with the BetaBanner at top: 0 z-[60]) covers approx 100-110px of vertical space. pt-24 == 96px → top of skip-button row sits ~96px from viewport top → overlapped ~10px by Nav. Playwright reports the overlap explicitly: 'subtree intercepts pointer events' from <header data-testid=site-nav>. Reproduction: open /welcome in a real browser, hover 'Just browsing →' in top-right — cursor doesn't show pointer affordance, click does nothing visible. Mitigation: increase top padding (pt-32 / pt-36) OR render Welcome with a different layout that omits the site-wide Nav, OR add `mt-4` to the progress/skip row, OR lift the row to z-[51].
